description: The file defines a React component for the upload page of a Next.js application, allowing users to upload CSV files with energy consumption data, preview the parsed data, and navigate to the dashboard or send data to backend.

methods.name: UploadInner
methods.description: Main React component handling the upload page UI, file parsing, state management, and navigation.
